newsitem.title: USA: AMR sets $500 mln share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: AMR sets $500 mln share repurchase.

text.p: AMR Corp, the parent of American Airlines, said Wednesday it may repurchase up to $500 million in stock over the next two years.

Based on Tuesday's closing price of $95.06 a share, the $500 million buyback plan would cover about 5.26 million shares, the company said. AMR had about 92 milion shares outstanding during the second quarter ended June 30.

The new share buyback plan will be added to the repurchase program authorization by the board in April for 5.75 million shares to offset dilution from options that were issued to American Airlines pilots as part their contract settlement.
As of June 30, about 33 percent of those shares had been repurchased at an average price of $95.16 a share.
